act.name: Indian Easements Act, 1882
act.source_authority: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing easements, rights of way, necessity, prescription and licences.

sections.title: Acquisition by prescription.
sections.text: Section 15 concerns acquisition of easement rights by prescription; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains when long, open and uninterrupted use may mature into an easementary right.
